Additional context

I have been on the unity-6 branch since late June (which I believe used Unity 6000.0.60f1). During that period I never experienced this TDR or crash. Windows kernel live dumps on this machine from June to early September contain no TDR attributed to VRChat.exe (the only 0x141 live dump in that period, on 2026-06-14, was attributed to Discord's overlay helper). All four VRChat-attributed TDRs occurred after the client moved to Unity 6000.0.67f1 (UnityPlayer.dll built 2026-09-11, builds 1915-1919).

Troubleshooting already done (to save a round-trip):

Hardware / system

- No overclock (GPU/CPU/RAM at stock), GPU temps < 70°C under load

- OCCT VRAM test: 0 errors

- Windows WHEA errors: 0

- No BSODs related to this issue

Drivers

- Reproduced on NVIDIA 610.74 and 610.88 (clean install with DDU)

- 616.92 caused additional TDRs in other apps, so I rolled back to 610.88

- TdrDelay is at the Windows default (I briefly tested 10 s; the TDR still occurred, so the GPU work was genuinely hung, not just slow)

Isolation

- Happens in both VR (Quest 3 via Virtual Desktop) and desktop (--no-vr)

- Different worlds, different own avatars, different instance members each time

- Crypto miner / other GPU-heavy apps were NOT running in the VRChat-attributed cases (confirmed from the GPU process list in the WATCHDOG dumps)

- Other D3D apps (osu!lazer) only failed as collateral when VRChat caused the TDR

- No VRChat-attributed TDR during the Unity 6000.0.60 era of the unity-6 branch (June to early September)

In progress

- Running with --disable-hw-video-decoding since <10/04>. No TDR/crash so far, but playtime has been limited, so this is not conclusive yet. Will update.

Happy to run any specific test or provide more dumps.

Update (2026-10-10)

- OCCT 3D Adaptive (Variable and Switch modes) and OCCT VRAM test: 0 errors. No WHEA errors. Hardware failure seems unlikely.

- TDR severity depends on whether VRChat is running:

  - 10/09 TDR (guilty: msedgewebview2), VRChat NOT running: single reset, everything recovered.

  - 10/10 TDR (guilty: msedgewebview2), VRChat running: 11 consecutive TDR events including "Restarting TDR"; VRChat crashed and dwm.exe crashed.

  So when VRChat (Unity 6) is running, device-removed recovery escalates instead of completing.

- Next: testing NVIDIA 596.49 (pre-R610) to see whether TDR frequency changes.

details:
Summary

Since the Unity 6 builds (2026.3.3, Unity 6000.0.67f1-DWR), VRChat intermittently triggers a GPU timeout (LiveKernelEvent 0x141, VIDEO_ENGINE_TIMEOUT_DETECTED). The Windows live dump identifies VRChat.exe as the guilty process. A few seconds after the TDR, VRChat hard-crashes (no crash handler) with an access violation writing to address 0 on the UnityGfxDeviceWorker thread. It looks like a Map/allocation returns NULL after the device is removed and the result is not checked.

Occurrences (JST)

- 2026-09-21 23:58  build 1915  driver 610.74  Desktop  DominoRooftop

- 2026-09-22 01:54  build 1915  driver 610.74  VR       Binaural ASMR Room

- 2026-09-28 04:51  build 1917  driver 610.88  VR       small room

- 2026-10-03 20:19  build 1919  driver 610.88  Desktop  Idle Home

All four: different worlds, modes and players. The only common factor is that an AVPro video player was playing YouTube via "MF-MediaEngine-Hardware" (640x360).

Crash signature (identical in all VRChat dumps)

- Exception: 0xC0000005, write to 0x0

- Thread: UnityGfxDeviceWorker

- Crash IP: UnityPlayer.dll+0x19eb468 / +0x19eb3ff (AVX memcpy, dst = NULL, size 0x40 / 0x100)

- Call chain: UnityPlayer.dll+0x6cca4b -> +0x1f09940 -> +0x4c3837 -> +0x11cd377 -> +0x1167b70

- nvlddmkm Event ID 153 is logged ~3-5 s before each crash.

- In the 10/03 event, another D3D11 app running at the same time (osu!lazer) also received DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_REMOVED and exited.

Expected

VRChat should recover from (or at least handle) device removal instead of writing to a NULL mapped pointer.

System

- GPU: GeForce RTX 5060 Ti 16GB (Palit, stock clocks, <70°C under load)

- CPU: Ryzen 7 9700X / RAM: 64GB

- OS: Windows 11 25H2 (26200), D3D11

- HMD: Quest 3 via Virtual Desktop

- Hardware checks: OCCT VRAM test 0 errors, 0 WHEA errors, no overclock

- Drivers tested: 610.74, 610.88 (also 616.92, which caused more TDRs in general)

Not yet tested

- --disable-hw-video-decoding (will update)

Logs and dumps (output_log, VRChat crash .dmp, WATCHDOG .dmp) are available and will be submitted via a support ticket referencing this post.
title: [Unity 6] TDR caused by VRChat.exe during AVPro HW-decoded video playback, then hard crash in UnityGfxDeviceWorker (NULL memcpy in UnityPlayer.dll)
